workflows.description: Find where a value reaches a server-side interpreter and whether a parameterized or allow-listed path is used
prerequisites: A supplied read-only source snapshot; deployment exposure is not established.

workflows.description: Reproduce the interpreter and the suspected sink with a local, disposable copy of its data
prerequisites: Bounded execution in your own sandbox scratch; network egress is available and any download or install must be receipted.

workflows.description: Boundary-class markers, then the interpreter's own effect
prerequisites: Requests through the run's HTTP transport to the target and any host it names; the supplied target is a starting label, not an egress boundary.

workflows.description: Confirm outbound reachability against any host or port the sandbox can route to, and record the response; opaque commands are not origin-filtered.
prerequisites: TCP or TLS exchange through the sandbox network tool to any host and port the sandbox can route to; opaque commands are not origin-filtered.
